summary: Constructs formatted resource-path strings into the target object using string components resolved through BinarySearchInStringTable against the global table byte_5EC4C0, with byte_5EC4CC as the working buffer. Always resolves the base component off_5C3774 into this+40. When the format selector at this+4 is nonzero, stores components at this+8 and this+24, builds "%s/%s" at this+56 and "%s/%s/%s" at this+72, and copies off_5C373C to this+88. When the selector is zero, uses the alternate component set (off_5C3770, byte_5C376C, aN, aMm, aM, aS_2, byte_5C3748) to build the same two formatted paths at this+56 and this+72 plus a single string at this+88.

Copy the resolved base component from byte_5EC4CC to this+40 (always, before the format-selector branch).
Branch on the format selector flag at this+4: nonzero selects the first template set, zero selects the alternate set.
Resolve off_5C3744 via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result to this+8.
Resolve byte_5C3740 via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result to this+24.
Resolve off_5C3700 via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result into local buffer v47.
Resolve byte_5C3740 into local buffer v46 via StringCopyWithReturn and strcpy.
Format the two-component path into this+56 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the "%s/%s" template aSSS and components v47, v46.
Resolve aS_2 into local buffer v48 via StringCopyWithReturn and strcpy.
Format the three-component path into this+72 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck using the "%s/%s/%s" template aSS_1 and components v47, v46, v48.
Copy the resolved off_5C373C string into this+88 via StringCopyWithReturn and strcpy.
Alternate set: resolve off_5C3770 via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result to this+8.
Alternate set: resolve byte_5C376C via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result to this+24.
Alternate set: resolve aN via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result into local buffer v47.
Alternate set: resolve aMm via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result into local buffer v46.
Alternate set: format the two-component path into this+56 with the "%s/%s" template aSSS and components v47, v46.
Alternate set: resolve aM via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result back into local buffer v46.
Alternate set: resolve aS_2 via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result into local buffer v48.
Alternate set: format the three-component path into this+72 with the "%s/%s/%s" template aSS_1 and components v47, v46, v48.
Alternate set: resolve byte_5C3748 via BinarySearchInStringTable and copy the result to this+88.
Return the final copied string pointer (result), which points into the working buffer byte_5EC4CC on the alternate branch.
